plan: A jungler who walks through walls and hides inside his victim's body.
aSurveiller: His R (Umbral Trespass). He hides inside your body then bursts out dealing big damage: your allies can't reach him meanwhile.
contrer: Watch the walls: he passes through them with his E.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: in red form he heals.
Don't drag out a fight alone: he needs to damage you to use his R.

sorts.P: Transforms into an assassin or a fighter.
sorts.W: Strike in a line that slows.

momentFort: Plays for his transformation: he farms a lot early. Use that window to invade him before he picks his form.
